decree.jaymoskingdoms.smiths.words: Timber, stone and iron are wanted. Let building and mending be posted first.
decree.jaymoskingdoms.hunters.words: Whatever prowls near this town is to be hunted down. Let the hunts be posted first.
decree.jaymoskingdoms.farmers.words: The stores run low. Let food and beasts for the pens be asked for first.
decree.jaymoskingdoms.war.words: This town is at war. Let the watch, the wanted and the taken be seen to first.
decree.jaymoskingdoms.pin: Pin it on a town board to steer what's posted there.
decree.jaymoskingdoms.stands: Posted %1$s. It stands about %2$s more day(s).
decree.jaymoskingdoms.same: There's a %s on this board already.
decree.jaymoskingdoms.earned: %1$s thanks you with a %2$s. Pin it on any board.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.decree.posting.1: Make way. %s, read it and heed it.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.copy: Your copy. Hold it to see how far along you are.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.early: Back early: there's something extra for that.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.missed: Too late for "%1$s". They've given up waiting on you (-%2$s with %3$s).
notice.jaymoskingdoms.not_here: That's work for another town's board.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.capture: Bring them to %s yourself; they won't be left tied to a post.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.about: %s is about. Take it to them.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.handed_in: Left at the board for %s, and the pay taken from the box under it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.land.shore.kel: The drying racks stand empty and the smokehouse wants fuel. %1$s %2$s, if you would.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.land.shore.cod: The boats came back light again. %1$s %2$s would keep the stall open.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.land.shore.wre: A hull came ashore past the point. Whoever was aboard isn't asking for it back. Mind the tide.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.land.river.cla: The potter's run dry and the good clay's down at the bend. %1$s %2$s, please.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.land.river.sal: The salmon are running and we've nobody at the weir. %1$s %2$s for the smoking.
The smith says the seam above the pass runs red. %1$s %2$s, and mind the drop.
If you hear your name called up on the slope at dusk, don't answer. It's only the echo. Probably.
There's colour in the dry wash after rain. Bring %1$s %2$s and we'll call it fair.
The kiln's cracked and the new walls won't wait. %1$s %2$s from the red cliffs.
The old mine is shut for a reason. The rails go further down than anyone dug.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.land.forest.mu: Stew's thin without them. %1$s %2$s from under the old trees, the brown ones only.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.land.forest.ho: No wax, no candles. %1$s %2$s, and go gently with the hives.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.land.jungle.ba: The rains got in again. %1$s %2$s to patch the roofs before the next.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.land.cherry.pe: The blossom festival needs its garlands. %1$s %2$s, the pinkest you can find.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.land.cherry.ho: Bees love the groves this time of year. %1$s %2$s for the festival cakes.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.land.cherry.bl: Blossom festival under the big tree at dusk. Lanterns welcome. Sneezing excused.
The walls want daubing before the wet season. %1$s %2$s from the flats.
The boardwalk's rotten past the third post. Keep to the roots, and keep your boots on.
Our red cow wandered off. Any red cow will do. Bring %1$s %2$s on a lead.
The healer wants red caps for her salves. %1$s %2$s, picked whole.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.land.pale.resi: The pale trees weep resin that the glaziers prize. %1$s %2$s. Go by day.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.land.pale.quie: Don't stare at the trees in the pale wood. If one looks back, walk on.
